path.description: Sandbox-relative path to ingest and view (e.g. tmp/animal.png).

url.description: HTTPS URL to fetch into MediaStore and view (SSRF-safe host fetch). Prefer short clips (~10s video). Large/long media may be rejected or soft-warned; private/metadata IPs blocked.

op.description: view (default): resolve and add. list: current set. drop: remove one att_id. clear: empty set.

note.description: Optional short caption used only on first promote of this att_id this moment (not a describe mode).
